items.name: The Widened Aperture
items.gesture: the local question opens onto a larger one, explicitly left unanswered

items.name: The Returned Key
items.gesture: reprises the opening image or example with its meaning reversed

items.name: The Burden Shift
items.gesture: relocates the onus of proof onto the previously comfortable side

items.name: The Practical Deflation
items.gesture: a grand theoretical movement lands on a deliberately small practical implication

items.name: The Residue
items.gesture: states precisely what remains unexplained after the best available account

items.name: The Horizon Clause
items.gesture: endorses the thesis 'until X changes' — conditions its own obsolescence

items.name: The Quiet Verdict
items.gesture: one flat declarative judgment after sustained even-handedness

items.name: The Displacement
items.gesture: resolves the original tension by showing a different tension matters more

items.name: The Cost Disclosure
items.gesture: affirms the position and names its price in the same breath

items.name: The Open Ledger
items.gesture: enumerates what each side still owes the debate

items.name: The Retrospective Frame
items.gesture: the final paragraph reveals the vantage point the whole passage was written from

items.name: The Scale Exit
items.gesture: jumps scales in the last lines, suspending the argument between them

items.name: The Instrument Doubt
items.gesture: closes by questioning the analytic tools the passage itself used

items.name: The Minor Character Promotion
items.gesture: a side consideration becomes, in the last paragraph, the main event

items.name: The Refused Synthesis
items.gesture: explicitly declines the available middle ground, and gives the reason

items.name: The Time Bomb
items.gesture: notes a pending fact that will force the question to be re-asked

items.name: The Narrowed Claim
items.gesture: the thesis survives only at drastically reduced scope; the ending performs the reduction

items.name: The Anti-Conclusion
items.gesture: argues why concluding now would itself be an error

items.name: The Handover
items.gesture: passes the question to a different discipline or authority as more competent

items.name: The Earned Banality
items.gesture: arrives at a truism — and shows the truism now means something different
